blockingIssues.problem: The description tells borrowers to collect reserved tools "at any time during desk opening hours," which contradicts the source instruction that pickups must follow the pickup window printed on each confirmation.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "The pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies." Also: "During those five days, existing West Room reservations will be collected at the North Desk..." The source does not authorize replacing the printed pickup window with a broader 'any time during desk opening hours' allowance.
blockingIssues.constraint: Pickup must occur during the pickup window printed on each confirmation; the notice must not state or imply that borrowers may pick up outside that confirmed pickup window.
